card.name: Words that start a trailing modifier
card.fires_on: A participle or relative word right after a noun that begins a clause describing it, such as 'used', 'conducted', 'which' or 'that'. It also fires on a noun like 'drugs' before 'that are metabolized'.

modes.label: Participle after noun
modes.description: Words like 'used' or 'conducted' that follow a noun and introduce a modifying phrase.
modes.example: suggests that the risk applies to all AEDs<< used>> for any indication.

modes.label: Relative word
modes.description: 'which' or 'that' opening a clause that describes the preceding noun.
modes.example: networks,<< which>> owe much to his own research.

modes.label: Noun before relative clause
modes.description: A noun such as 'drugs' that is followed by a clause saying which ones are meant.
modes.example: interfere with the metabolism of other<< drugs>> that are metabolized by cytochrome
